environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance with public-facing Application Load Balancer (internet-facing ALB with target group pointing to port 3000). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request timeout configured at ALB level (default 60s idle timeout). No WAF attached. Route53 public hosted zone with A-record alias to ALB.

config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0:443 inbound
